x: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ سَیِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ السَّابِقِ لِلْخَلْقِ نُورُهُ وَرَحْمَةٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ ظُهُورُهُ عَدَدَ مَنْ مَضَى مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَمَنْ بَقِيَ وَمَنْ سَعِدَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ شَقِيَ صَلَاةً تَسْتَغْرِقُ الْعَدَدَ وَتُحِيطُ بِالْحَدِّ صَلَاةً لَا غَايَةَ لَهَا وَلَا مُنْتَهَى وَلَا انْقِضَاءَ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً بِدَوَامِكَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيمًا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.

Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin — as-sābiqi li-l-khalqi nūruh, wa raḥmatan li-l-ʿālamīna ẓuhūruh — ʿadada man maḍā min khalqika wa man baqiy, wa man saʿida minhum wa man shaqiy; ṣalātan tastaghriqu l-ʿadada wa tuḥīṭu bi-l-ḥadd; ṣalātan lā ghāyata lahā wa lā muntahā wa lā nqiḍāʾ; ṣalātan dāʾimatan bi-dawāmik; wa ʿalā ālihi wa aṣḥābihi wa sallim taslīman mithla dhālik.

O Allāh, bless our master Muḥammad — whose light preceded creation, whose appearing was a mercy to the worlds — by the number of those of Your creation who have passed away and those who remain, those among them who are felicitous and those who are wretched. A blessing that exhausts all number and encompasses every limit; a blessing that has no end, no term and no expiry; a blessing enduring with Your endurance. And upon his family and his Companions, and grant them peace in like measure.
